_comment: Static fallback for the freshness strip. This file documents the shape of
the status.json each project's CI publishes, and holds the last values
that were verified by hand. The strip's inline HTML is generated from
these values, so a visitor with no JS, a failed fetch or a 404 still sees
real numbers instead of a spinner.
Only figures that can be verified from a project's own artefacts appear
here. rows and last_ingest are null on purpose: they are runtime facts
that only the live feed can supply, and inventing them would defeat the
point of the strip. They render as an em dash.
